user_query: I'm planning a family trip to a new city and I need some recommendations for local attractions and restaurants. Could you provide me with a list of webtoons from the Manga Scrapper tool? Additionally, I would like to know the horoscope predictions for each family member during our trip.

TaskList.description: Search for local attractions in the new city.
Find suitable restaurants in the new city based on local attractions.
Scrape a list of webtoons using the Manga Scrapper tool.
Retrieve horoscope predictions for each family member for the duration of the trip.
